notes: text: ジンは私の従兄 — Jin is my cousin
text: 一番古い記憶は…ジンの後ろ姿ね — my earliest memory is... Jin's back as he walked away

english: a view of someone from behind, a retreating figure
notes: text: 走っていく彼の後についていく私 — me, following behind him as he ran off (referring to his 後ろ姿)
text: ジンが試験を受けたのはあなたと同じ12歳になる少し前 — Jin took the exam a bit before he turned 12, same as you
text: 結局何が欲しいのか教えてもらえなくて — in the end (he) never told me what he wanted
text: あたしが一方的にわめいてただけだけど — though it was just me one-sidedly yelling at him
text: あたしが一方的にわめいてただけだけど — though it was just me yelling one-sidedly
text: それ以来会わないままジンは島を出た — after that, Jin left the island without us ever meeting again
text: ジンはあたしの長男の一人息子 — Jin is my eldest son's only son
text: ミトは次男の一人娘でね — Mito is my second son's only daughter
text: 交通事故で死んだのはミトの両親の方なのさ — it was Mito's parents who died in a traffic accident
text: 死んだのはミトの両親の方なのさ — it was Mito's parents who died
text: 後を追うようにジンの父親も漁から還らなかった — as if chasing after him, Jin's father too never returned from fishing

english: a travel destination, a place visited on a trip
notes: text: 年に一度行くか行かないかの旅先でね — at a travel destination he'd visit maybe once a year
text: 実は何も知らないの — actually, I don't know anything

english: for the first time in ~ (a period of time)
notes: text: 10年ぶりに帰ってきて — coming back for the first time in 10 years

english: to look after, to take charge of
notes: text: このコをしばらく預かってくれないかって言うんだよ — (he) asked if I could look after this child for a while

english: and that was the last of it, since then (nothing more)
notes: text: 別れたってそれっきりでね — we parted ways and that was the last of it
text: 親権を移して — transferring custody (of the child)
text: 親権を移して — transferring custody
text: 酷いことしたわね — that was a cruel thing to do
text: 島に戻って来ないでって泣き叫んで大変だったんだよ — (she) cried and wailed not to go back to the island, it was quite a scene
text: とにかく!! — anyway!!
text: 何度捨てられたかわからないよねェ — who knows how many times it's been thrown away
text: 何度も捨てたのはおばあちゃんがまた拾って元の場所に戻すから — no matter how many times I threw it out, Grandma would pick it up again and put it back

english: the original place, where something was before
notes: text: 元の場所に戻すから — because she'd put it back in its original place
text: 元の場所に戻すから — because she'd put it back

english: a trash can, a garbage box
notes: text: 家のゴミ箱に入れないで埋めるなり燃やすなりするもんさ — instead of putting it in the house's trash can, you'd bury it or burn it
text: 埋めるなり燃やすなりするもんさ — you'd bury it or burn it
text: 埋めるなり燃やすなりするもんさ — you'd bury it or burn it
text: その箱以外手がかりになるようなことは何にも残しちゃいないのよ — aside from that box, he didn't leave behind anything that could be a clue

english: nothing at all (emphatic, colloquial for 何も)
notes: text: 何にも残しちゃいないのよ — he didn't leave behind anything at all

english: to feel right, to fit naturally
notes: text: 名前で呼んだ方がしっくり来る気がするんだけど — I just feel like calling him by name fits better
text: ジンには同い年の友達っていなかったの? — didn't Jin have any friends the same age?

english: to become lost, to get lost
notes: text: 何度もあんた迷子になったんだよね — you got lost so many times, you know

english: to remember (colloquial for 覚えている)
notes: text: そんなことばっかり覚えてる — that's all you remember
text: 村中大騒ぎなんて事が度々さ — the whole village would be in an uproar, it happened often
text: 島中総出で山探し…としきりだったらしいね — the whole island turning out to search the mountains for her, apparently quite often
text: あんまりそれが続くからあんた達2人のイタズラじゃないかってウワサが出たほどだよ — it kept happening so much that a rumor even came out that it might be a prank by you two
text: あんた達2人のイタズラじゃないかってウワサが — a rumor that it might be a prank by you two
text: イタズラじゃないかってウワサが出たほどだよ — a rumor even came out

english: to stay still, to remain motionless
notes: text: どんなとこでミトがじっとしてててもね — no matter where Mito stayed still
text: まるで隠れてるんじゃないかってくらいうずくまってるんだもの — it's like she's practically hiding, crouched up like that
text: 見ーつけた — found you!

english: come to think of it, by the way
notes: text: そーいえばこんなこともあったわ — oh, come to think of it, this happened too
text: ジンと2人で舟に乗っててねー — the two of you, Jin and you, were on a boat together
text: なるほど — I see
text: どーやって開けるんだ — how do you open it

english: to put in effort, to apply strength
notes: text: ちょっと力入れていいか? — mind if I put a little strength into it?
text: いろいろ試したんだけど — I tried all sorts of things

english: no matter what, try as one might
notes: text: どうしても開かないんだよ — it just won't open no matter what
text: 溶接されてたってねじ開けられるのに — even if it were welded shut you could pry it open
text: ただの鉄箱だったら溶接されてたってねじ開けられるのに — if it were just an ordinary iron box, even welded shut you could pry it open
text: 溶接されてたってねじ開けられるのに — even if it were welded shut

english: to make no sound, to be silent
notes: text: 音しねーな — it's not making a sound
text: ブチ壊すわけにもいかねーしな — but I can't just smash it either
text: もしかしてハンターになったら…… — maybe if (you) became a Hunter...
text: 差し込み口とかどこにもないよ — there's no insertion slot or anything anywhere
text: 念だよ念!! — it's Nen, Nen!! 念 ordinarily means "sense, thought, attentiveness"; here it's the manga's term for its aura-based power system

english: to adhere, to bond, to stick together
notes: text: 全然接着した跡もない — there's no trace of it having been bonded at all
text: 全然接着した跡もない — no trace of it at all

english: to have seen (something) before, to look familiar
notes: text: この見覚えないか? — doesn't this look familiar to you?
text: ウイングさんがくれた誓いの糸に似たような模様が描いてあった — a pattern similar to the Oath Thread Wing gave him was drawn on it

english: to rig, to build in, to prepare in advance
notes: text: 念を使うと切れるように仕込んであるんだって言ってたよな — he said it was rigged so it could be cut by using Nen
text: 指輪の裏にもあの模様 — that same pattern is on the back of the ring too
text: 指輪の裏にもあの模様 — on the back of the ring too
text: うかつにはめない方がいいかもな — might be better not to carelessly put it on

english: to put on, to wear (a ring)
notes: text: うかつにはめない方がいいかもな — better not to carelessly put it on

english: just in case, to be sure
notes: text: 念のためさ — just to be sure
text: ダビングの準備もな — prep for the dubbing too

english: want to meet, want to see (someone)
notes: text: お前オレに会いたいか? — do you want to see me?
text: 暗い斜面をひたすら登る — climbing steadily up a dark slope (author's Egypt travel column)
text: 暗い斜面をひたすら登る — climbing steadily up a dark slope

english: a burial chamber (of a pyramid or tomb)
notes: text: 玄室らしき場所についた — arrived at what seemed to be the burial chamber
text: ピラミッド内部の見学は1日300人と決められていて — the pyramid interior tour is limited to 300 people a day
text: 他に10数人の外国人観光客が…たむろしていた — more than a dozen other foreign tourists were hanging around

english: to loiter, to hang around in a group
notes: text: 外国人観光客が5m×10mほどの玄室にたむろしていた — foreign tourists were hanging around in the roughly 5m x 10m chamber
text: 室内の中央あたりで妙な唸り声が聞こえてきた — a strange groaning sound could be heard from around the center of the room
text: 妙な唸り声が聞こえてきた — a strange groaning sound could be heard
text: 抑揚のない合唱である — a toneless, monotone chorus
text: 抑揚のない合唱である — a toneless chorus
text: 音合わせのためにコーラス隊がドの声を発声し — the choir sounded a "do" note to tune their pitch

english: to vocalize, to utter a sound
notes: text: コーラス隊がドの声を発声し — the choir sounded a "do" note
text: 延々とそれを続けては感じだ — it felt like they kept it up endlessly
text: 誰かがフラッシュをたいて、一瞬彼らの姿が見えた — someone's flash went off, and for an instant their figures were visible
text: 年配の男性が多かったが若い女性もいた — mostly older men, but there were young women too

english: to form a circle, a ring
notes: text: 輪になって手をつなぎ — forming a circle, holding hands
text: 輪になって手をつなぎ — forming a circle, holding hands

english: to hold up, to raise high
notes: text: その手を高くかかげて — raising their hands up high

english: to be taken aback, to be put off (colloquial, of a reaction)
notes: text: 他の観光客も我々と同じくひいていたと思う — I think the other tourists were just as put off as we were

english: paying no heed to, without regard for
notes: text: そんな我々にはおかまいなしに彼らは — paying no attention to us at all, they...
text: 「してやったり」とばかりお互い抱き合い — as if to say "we did it!", they embraced each other
text: お互い抱き合い — embracing each other

english: to stick to, to cling to (a surface)
notes: text: 玄室の壁にはりついてまた低い声でほえ始めた — clinging to the chamber wall, they began growling again in low voices

english: to bark, to howl, to roar
notes: text: また低い声でほえ始めた — began growling again in low voices
text: 私達他の客が写真をとる度に「我々を撮らないでくれ」などと言っていた — every time we or other visitors took a photo, they'd say things like "don't photograph us"
